title: In Situ Quantification of Abdominal Aortic Aneurysms
author: Alan Daugherty
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.ix7cfrn

steps.title: Dissect and fix aortas
steps.instruction: Cut open the mouse ventrally, perfuse with saline, dissect the aorta, then place the dissected aortas in 4 % paraformaldehyde or 10 % neutral‑buffered formalin for 24–48 h; after fixation keep them in saline at room temperature or 2–8 °C, soak in saline for a few hours before cleaning, and clean by removing adventitial tissue while keeping the tissue moist with saline and avoiding tears or nicking of the aorta and its branches.

substeps.instruction: Perfuse mouse ventrally with saline and dissect the aorta.
Fix aorta in 4 % paraformaldehyde or 10 % neutral‑buffered formalin for 24–48 h.
Store fixed aortas in saline at room temperature or 2–8 °C.
Soak aortas in saline for a few hours before cleaning.
Clean by removing adventitial tissue, keeping tissue moist with saline and avoiding tears.

steps.title: Pin aorta on black wax
steps.instruction: Pin each aorta onto black wax using Fine Science Tools pins #26002‑20, apply saline to keep it moist, label the mouse number on both the lid and the wax box, and complete imaging and analysis within three days of pinning.

substeps.instruction: Pin aorta onto black wax with Fine Science Tools pins #26002‑20.
Apply saline to keep the aorta moist.
Label mouse number on lid and wax box.

steps.title: Capture calibrated aorta images
steps.instruction: Photograph the pinned aorta using a Nikon digital camera, ensuring the abdominal region, main branches, and a millimeter ruler are included; save each image as a TIFF file.

steps.title: Calibrate images in Image Pro
steps.instruction: Open Image Pro (version 5.0 or 7.0), load the image, choose Measure → Calibrate → Spatial calibration, use the wizard or click New, draw a line over the ruler, set reference units to mm, then click OK and Apply.

steps.title: Annotate images with study info
steps.instruction: In Image Pro, open the image, click the annotation button (O) → Aa, enter study name, mouse number, and date, click OK, burn the label to the image using the double‑arrow (bb) icon, and save the annotated image; repeat for all images.

steps.title: Measure aortic width
steps.instruction: Select the appropriate calibration (Measure → Calibration → Set system → Apply), then choose Measure → Measurements, select the Line tool, place the line on the maximal outer width of the suprarenal aortic region, and adjust the line position with the arrow (a) button as needed.

steps.title: Export measurements and save image
steps.instruction: Click Input/Output, select Measurements, and click Export now to send data to a spreadsheet; then, in Input/Output, save the image as “mouse#....msr”, optionally print the image with overlay, and keep the image open until it has been printed, saved, and the measurements recorded.

steps.title: Verify data and store aortas
steps.instruction: Have a second, blinded observer verify the quantification; after verification, unpin the aortas, place them in properly labeled tubes containing saline with 0.02 % sodium azide, and store at room temperature.
